title: WHY IS IT CALLED BLACK FRIDAY?

lines.text: It's the day after Thanksgiving. Millions of people are lining up before sunrise, and prices are crashing everywhere.
lines.caption: It's the day after Thanksgiving. Millions of people are lining up before sunrise, and prices are crashing everywhere.

lines.text: So why would anyone name a day this exciting — Black Friday?
lines.caption: So why would anyone name a day this exciting — Black Friday?

lines.text: Most people will tell you it's about money. Stores spend the year in the red, and this is the day their books finally flip into the black.
lines.caption: Most people will tell you it's about money. Stores spend the year in the red, and this is the day their books finally flip into the black.

lines.text: It's a great story. It just isn't the original one.
lines.caption: It's a great story. It just isn't the original one.

lines.text: Rewind to Philadelphia, in the nineteen fifties and sixties.
lines.caption: Rewind to Philadelphia, in the nineteen fifties and sixties.

lines.text: Every year, the day after Thanksgiving, shoppers flooded downtown — right before the big Army-Navy football game that Saturday.
lines.caption: Every year, the day after Thanksgiving, shoppers flooded downtown — right before the big Army-Navy football game that Saturday.

lines.text: Police officers couldn't take the day off — so they gave it a grim nickname: Black Friday.
lines.caption: Police officers couldn't take the day off — so they gave it a grim nickname: Black Friday.

lines.text: Store owners hated it. They even tried rebranding it as Big Friday. It didn't stick.
lines.caption: Store owners hated it. They even tried rebranding it as Big Friday. It didn't stick.

lines.text: So years later, a happier explanation spread — red ink turning black. By the nineteen eighties, that's the version everyone told.
lines.caption: So years later, a happier explanation spread — red ink turning black. By the nineteen eighties, that's the version everyone told.

lines.text: Today, Black Friday reaches Canada, Britain, and far beyond — and more of it happens on phones than ever.
lines.caption: Today, Black Friday reaches Canada, Britain, and far beyond — and more of it happens on phones than ever.

lines.text: So the name on every sale banner you'll see today — started as a police complaint.
lines.caption: So the name on every sale banner you'll see today — started as a police complaint.
